g.text: Triage & Flank Monitoring System for WWF Nepal Tiger Survey
Collects and extracts raw camera-trap SD card images
Manages asynchronous processing queue via BackgroundTasks
Extracts image metadata, feeds AI engine, logs database records
MegaDetector V6 (YOLOv9-c) + Laplacian Variance Blur Check
Checks empty frames vs wildlife objects. Blurs are gated (Day > 40.0, Night > 12.0)
Outputs: BLUR | NON_OBJECT (Empty) | OBJECT (Continue to L2)
Extracts crops from L1 detections. Triggers Tiger flag on Class Index 292
Outputs: TIGER (Continue to L3) | HUMAN | OTHER_WILDLIFE (ImageNet labels mapping)
Evaluates Full-Frame context (matches training) to prevent domain-mismatch errors
Outputs: LEFT FLANK | RIGHT FLANK | UNCERTAIN FLANK (< 0.60 confidence score)
Stores raw uploads and MegaDetector AI crops
Stores image classification tags, paths, confidences, & surveys
